name: How long does tub removal usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does tub removal usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many tub removals take a few hours, but the timeline depends on the tub material, whether tile must come off, and whether plumbing or subfloor repair is needed. A simple removal is faster than a cast-iron tub or a full tub-to-shower conversion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Simple removals can take just a few hours, but older tubs, heavy materials, or added repair work can extend the job to a full day or more.
